description: This file is a shell script that defines a sequence of tests for git cherry-pick functionality, particularly regarding cherry-picking empty commits and handling various options and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup commands after a test completes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of HEAD.
